search_window.basis: Verified 15:50:50 PST prior heartbeat on ops/watch-ledger; 2-3-day targeted discovery lookback only to catch delayed reporting and exclude duplicates.

coverage_notes.purpose: Supplementary Food Line high-value recall watch only; production nationwide collection remains authoritative.
target_classes: Loss of a community's only/sole/last/full-service grocery store from closure/fire/disaster
Emergency food distribution canceled/suspended because of storms, flood, fire, outage, facility damage
Abrupt pantry/food-bank service closure or major access reduction
Official SNAP/WIC/food assistance interruption with immediate access consequences
search_queries: "only grocery store" "November 8, 2026" closed OR fire OR flood
"sole grocery store" November 2026 flooded closed town
"food distribution" canceled OR cancelled November 8 2026 storm flood
"food pantry" "temporarily closed" "November 8" "2026" fire OR flood OR power
coverage_notes.search_recency: 2 or 3 days, with explicit November 8, 2026 / November 2026 terms

reviewed_exclusions.reason: McCaysville, GA sole grocery-store flood damage reported November 6 and documented in prior watches; not an in-window new signal.

November 6 Mecklenburg County power outage closed one office, but SNAP alternatives remained open via online, telephone and another resource center; predates window and is not a fresh benefits issuance interruption.
November 6 Kauaʻi local recovery article confirms foodbank mobile distribution scheduled, not canceled; hurricane resource centers are not food pantry closures.
Ongoing SNAP interview/renewal wait times; no newly dated acute interruption identified.
No newly dated SNAP/WIC interruption identified.
Search result describes a scheduled November 10 mobile distribution, not a canceled one; direct check blocked.
El Paso storm-damaged foodbank closure occurred in September 2026, outside window.
Page's November 8 SNAP shutdown chronology describes a past 2025 shutdown, not a new 2026 action.
Other results were old grocery losses, routine pantry event calendars, unrelated program guides, proposed rules, unverified secondary issuance calendars, or promotional resources.

source_or_search_failures.mitigation: Search snippet indicated a routine future distribution on Nov 10 and no cancellation, so limited source failure was nonmaterial to the target miss classes.

coverage_notes.coverage_assessment: All 12 searches ran; five of six direct pages opened. No new qualifying signal verified in the hourly interval. Search result quality was limited by many older or generic pages. One nonmaterial direct-source 403 requires DEGRADED under explicit watch rule.
coverage_notes.notification_assessment: No qualifying signal, and failed direct check concerned routine scheduled distribution with no evidence of a material coverage gap; no user notification.
coverage_notes.excluded_content: Donation drives, resource guides, recipes, opinion, routine program promotion, generic inflation stories, duplicates.
coverage_notes.controls: No approval, publication, production mutation, schedule modification or task disabling.
